reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies composition, processing, temperature/loading ranges, a control, direct LCO characterization, mechanical outcomes, and a falsification experiment, while grounding the general strengthening premise in prior LCO literature. Its weaknesses are that the 20–30% prediction is unsupported and 800 °C slow annealing may induce precipitation or phase separation in Ti-containing CoCrFeNiTi, so phase stability must be verified to isolate LCO.
